what: The section is pinned to the screen, and as you scroll (by the width of the card row) the card row flows left (scrub .5). Each card is tilted at random — rotation ±10~20°, horizontal ±30~50%, vertical ±20~30% — and passes through, tilting the opposite way, from entering at 110% on the right of the screen until leaving at −20% (scrub .4, no curve). The large opening title in the center turns off during the 50px in which the first card’s left edge passes the screen center, and the closing title turns on during the 100px before the last card’s right edge reaches 80% of the screen — photos pour past between the two phrases ‹From here … to there›.

options.tilt: Minimum tilt (°) — add 0 to 10 to this, default 10
options.dx: Minimum horizontal push (%) — adds 0 to 20, default 30
options.dy: Minimum vertical offset (%) — adds 0 to 10, default 20
options.--fx-gap: Gap between cards (css), default 30px — 120vw before and 20vw after the row are left empty so the first card enters from beyond the right edge
